market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. 5% yields and $103 oil create headwinds, but China truce and Iran deal hopes provide relief. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation favoring energy, cybersecurity, and AI networking over infrastructure. Nike Q1 and Oracle debt developments are key catalysts.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI sovereignty and networking themes (Palantir, AMD, Lumentum) offer structural growth. 5% rate regime favors income strategies (CLOs, floating rate). Housing remains challenged. Wealth transfer and analog economy themes gain relevance. China trade normalization supports global growth.
